description:
Adds bones, mulch, bonemeal, fertilizer and even gelatin into your world.

- Adds bones, mulch, bonemeal and fertilizer to help grow crops and saplings faster.
- Supports many 3rd party mods like Farming Redo, Ethereal, More Trees and more...
- Has Bone block, brick and tile nodes for building and easy bone storage.
- You can also craft gelatin powder from bones for the odd recipe as well.
